image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a realistic Triceratops model or statue standing on a dark wooden surface. The subject is a quadrupedal dinosaur with textured, scaly skin in shades of brown and tan. It features the characteristic three horns (two large brow horns, one smaller nasal horn) and a large, solid bony frill with marginal bumps (epoccipitals). The forelimbs appear shorter than the hindlimbs. A small black stand supports the belly area, indicating it is a display model. A small white card or tag is visible on the floor near the front feet.
